question: What alternative heights may be prescribed relative to the diameter?
premises: A height is to be made.
One option is half the diameter.
Another option is two parts out of thirty-two.
inference: One should make the height half the diameter, or else two thirty-second parts.
uncertainties: The referent of dvātriṃśaddvyaṃśam depends on the implied base measure.
plain_english: One should make the height half the diameter, or else two parts out of thirty-two.
